Whole event is one curved 16 cm MIP fragment in the detector corner; the second half averages ~75k against ~48k for the first, so it cools toward this end, but the trend rests on one 218k point plus weak means and rule 2 points the other way.

Rule 1 perfect: 3 of 3 prongs rise away from this deg-3 vertex, two of them short protons ending at 193812 and 140427, all three arrows green in the zoom.

Single 498 cm flat-MIP track; the other end sits on the z=500 face while this end is 33 cm inside the upstream face and far from every other wall, so the track must have been created here, and rules 1 and 2 both agree.

Lowest-z vertex of a messy shower event and the only one with rule-1 support -- 2 of 3 prongs rise away, to 193258 and to 205090 -- while the competing shower-cone apex 17 cm downstream has 0 of 3 and all-red arrows.
